label: Anxious
acknowledgment: Anxiety is not a flaw. The Quran speaks to this feeling with gentleness. These words have comforted hearts for 1400 years.

verses.translation_en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts find peace.
verses.context: Revealed in Makkah. The disbelievers had asked for a sign. Allah answered with this verse: peace is in His remembrance.

verses.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
verses.translation_en: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
verses.context: The closing of Surah Al-Baqarah, after a long series of tests and commands.

verses.translation_en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.
verses.context: The Arabic places ease with hardship, not after it. They are intertwined.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
verses.translation_en: And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for him.
verses.context: Tawakkul comes with effort. You do your part, then you place your trust in Allah.

verses.translation_en: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
verses.context: Said by Ibrahim when thrown into the fire. Said by the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ when facing an army.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا
verses.translation_en: Say, 'Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us.'
verses.context: Nothing reaches you without His permission, and what reaches you is measured.

verses.arabic: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.translation_en: Unquestionably, for the allies of Allah there will be no fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.context: A promise given to those who stay close to Him.

verses.translation_en: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
verses.context: No matter how far you feel, His mercy is wider.

verses.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
verses.translation_en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
verses.context: Closer than your own breath. Closer than your own thoughts.

verses.arabic: وَعَسَىٰ أَن تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَعَسَىٰ أَن تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ
verses.translation_en: And perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you.
verses.context: The moment does not decide the outcome. Allah does.

names_of_allah.explanation: Peace is something you return to. When your mind cannot settle, this name is a reminder that peace is already with Him.

evidence_verses.arabic: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ
evidence_verses.translation_en: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Source of Peace.

names_of_allah.explanation: He knows the smallest details of what you carry. He sees what no one else sees, and He does not turn away.

evidence_verses.translation_en: And He is the Subtly Kind, the Acquainted.
Allah is Subtly Kind to His servants.

names_of_allah.explanation: When you have done what you can, He handles what you cannot. Trust is not passive. It is what you do after you have done your part.

evidence_verses.translation_en: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

evidence_verses.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
evidence_verses.translation_en: And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for him.

names_of_allah.explanation: He preserves what you cannot protect. Your peace, your future, your loved ones. Nothing is lost with Him.

evidence_verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, my Lord is, over all things, a Preserver.
And your Lord is, over all things, a Preserver.

names_of_allah.explanation: He responds. When you call, He is already near.

evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, my Lord is Near and Responsive.
Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

names_of_allah.explanation: His mercy does not wait for you to deserve it. It is already with you.

evidence_verses.translation_en: The Most Compassionate, taught the Quran.
Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

names_of_allah.explanation: He is closer than your own jugular vein. Closeness is stated without condition, without distance, without delay.

evidence_verses.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
evidence_verses.translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

evidence_verses.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
evidence_verses.translation_en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

personal_question: When did you last feel at peace? Was it when you were close to Allah, or when you were far?
